title: Survey for badminton players
opening: I'm Mike Stoker, a badminton player in Milton Keynes and the developer of ePegboard. I'm asking players what club nights are like for them: how games are picked, how fair it feels, and how you find places to play. Your answers will help me decide what to build and test. It takes about 6 minutes. Giving your club name is optional.
afterSubmission: Thanks for taking part. If you'd like to try ePegboard features in development and give feedback, you can volunteer below. I'll use your email to invite you to testing and follow up on your feedback. You can leave the tester list at any time.
